name: Genie Music
description: Search Genie Music's songs, albums and artists, and open them from a link.
about: Genie Music adds Korea's Genie catalogue to Songstress's search: its songs, albums and artists appear beside what your library and your other sources find.
A Genie link to a song, an album or an artist opens as its page in Songstress.
useCases: Find a Korean release in Genie's catalogue, and add it to your library.
Open a genie.co.kr link to a song, an album or an artist.
howItWorks: Your server reads Genie Music's own search and detail pages, and its cover images, from genie.co.kr. It needs no account and keeps nothing.
It finds and opens music: it doesn't play or download it. Its results sit beside Songstress's own sources, never in their place.
